title: DECISION card frontmatter
description: Architecture decision record — one choice, the why, and the alternatives rejected. Connect it to every card the decision shaped; the body carries Context / Decision / Alternatives / Consequences. For a choice local to a single card, prefer append_note(kind: decision) on that card instead.

supersedes.description: Handle of an earlier DECISION card this one replaces. A structured ref: it must resolve (E005) and connects the two cards. Keep the superseded card — history is the point.
